items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I will never forget John Middlesworth, he was the high school coach and advisor

ctx.x: Basketball and track. I loved both and I love basketball and track today. I was a high jumper and a hurdler and I was a forward and center on the basketball team. It was some tough days but I will never forget John Middlesworth, he was the high school

coach and advisor, of course in those days the coach...he was the coach of the basketball team, the track team...it was all in one. And Joe Byers who was the coach of the basketball team and the track team at Pattongill High School ...Junior High...I'll never forget, Joe Byers and I, we went to Battle Creek and, you know, I was scorin' a lot of points and there was a couple of other guys who was doin' very well and we won, you see. But it was rough. The team was out there and this guy Joe...I'll never forget…
